purpose: Study real film shots for a scene the owner describes and turn them into a numeric shot recipe (keyframes, heights, lenses, easing, density, light, walk timing) for a Blender build; private study only, nothing copied.

model.notes: web search and reading stills; turning them into numbers can use opus for a big scene.

owner_approval: nothing from a film is ever published or used in our video; stills stay private study
evaluation: reference/FILM_REFERENCE.md lists each reference with where, camera, light, what works and the take, then a recipe with per-beat keyframe numbers, density, light and walk timing; no dialogue quoted; stills only in reference/stills.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Web search plus the youtube skill's yt_fetch.py; any model that reads images.
